shots.intent: Opening: an ordinary moment beside a staircase
shots.prompt: Preserve the exact fictional woman's face, age, teal blouse, beige trousers, house and dawn lighting. A subtle natural breath and slight shift of gaze toward the window; her right hand remains resting on the banister. Very slow stabilized camera push, plausible anatomy, no change in health or gait implied. No walking up stairs, no medical overlays, no text, no logos, no new people.

Preserve the exact fictional woman's face, clothing, table objects, notebook and courtyard. Tiny natural head movement and one small pen stroke, stable hand anatomy and consistent pen contact with paper. Slow lateral camera drift with subtle depth, no object morphing. Keep the smartphone face down. No invented interface, no diagnosis, no transformation or cure, no text and no logos.

acceptance: Stable stairs, banister, notebook and phone
No implied improvement in pain or mobility
Complete provenance and human review remain required
